Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
Implementation.source_section: 1. EVALUATION > 3. Quality and efficiency of the implementation (Score 3)

compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: the proposal must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it was submitted ('in scope'); partial out-of-scope must be reflected in scoring.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. OTHER QUESTIONS > Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Overall threshold: the sum of the three individual scores (0-5 each, one-decimal resolution) must reach the overall threshold of 70/100; weighting (50/30/20) applies only to ranking, not to threshold determination.
Exclusive focus on civil applications: the proposed activities must have an exclusive focus on civil applications; activities intended for military application or purposes cannot be funded.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. OTHER QUESTIONS > Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Ethics — use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): declare whether the proposal involves hESC and, if so, whether their use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. OTHER QUESTIONS > Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Ethics — use of human embryos: declare whether the proposal involves the use of human embryos and, if so, how they will be used.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. OTHER QUESTIONS > Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include human reproductive cloning, heritable genetic modification of humans, creation of human embryos solely for research/stem-cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. OTHER QUESTIONS > Activities excluded from funding
